Privacy Policy

Updated 19 November 2026

Processing and files

Images, PDFs and text are processed locally in your browser. Toolora does not upload or retain the content you enter. Downloaded files remain under your control. The hosting provider processes ordinary connection information such as IP addresses and request logs to deliver and secure the website.

Cookies, analytics and advertising

This version does not load analytics or advertising scripts and does not set tracking cookies. If these services are added, this policy and the consent controls must be updated before activation. Your language is determined by the URL.

Questions and updates

For privacy questions, use the Contact page. This policy describes this release and must be reviewed when services change.
